campaign_budget_status: unapproved; the readiness envelope is a comparator, never silently relabeled as the scientific budget

design.seeds: first 64 bits of SHA256(domain + ASCII '/' + decimal block index); reject collisions or development-seed overlap, never replace
design.candidate_selection: keyed fixed censuses, all retained living/dead cells; all retained novel-acquisition pairs; preserve empty, extinct, capped, unmeasured and inadmissible slots

inference.unit: independent seed block; four separate arm worlds sharing the block seed; no lineage/census pseudoreplication
inference.selection: smallest block count with exact joint power >= target in target scenario, evaluated before all scientific outcomes
inference.tests: one-sided exact binomial prevalence above a 20 percent decision floor; one-sided exact discordant-pair binomial sign/McNemar test plus >=20 percentage-point observed advantage; two alpha allocations sum to 0.05
inference.assumptions: scenario probabilities are sensitivity assumptions, not estimated from heterogeneous readiness fixtures; seed blocks modeled independent and identically distributed; exact power is conditional on that model

candidate.empty_ablation: retain inadmissible candidate; never add a founder gene
candidate.dependency: later gain with earlier present = intact minus padded_remove_later; later gain without earlier = padded_remove_earlier minus padded_remove_both; require first gain minus acquisition cost >=1, second gain minus acquisition cost <=0, and positive difference-of-differences
candidate.status: prospective rule under planning; two additional padded roles are not implemented by the current native request schema

decisions.cumulative_evolution: complete valid denominator and endogenous prevalence test passes with the full candidate rule
decisions.self_modification_advantage: cumulative_evolution plus exact paired advantage test and effect-size threshold passes
decisions.ordinary_mutation_success: report external prevalence using the same functional predicate, label external origins separately; it can pass the cumulative criterion
decisions.mechanical_control_violation: a qualifying nonheritable or frozen lineage invalidates accounting/measurement before scientific interpretation
decisions.missing_or_operational_failure: retain every planned world as unknown; withhold scientific acceptance, do not turn unknown into a negative result or drop it
decisions.valid_negative: complete scientifically valid panel failing cumulative criterion; close this configuration without new seeds or changed thresholds

closure: publish the complete sizing and resource audit; no native work, seed pilots, outcome-dependent sizing, budget expansion or scientific launch; unresolved campaign budget/adapter/confirmation requirements remain explicit
